disposition_reason: Twelve packaged pasta products and one wheat germ powder from Arak, Iran, analysed once each for As, Cd, Hg, Pb and Cu by ICP-AES.

study.design: retail survey, one sample per product
study.method: microwave HNO3/HCl digestion and ICP-AES, three emission lines, triplicate readings
study.qa: spike recoveries 92.1-104.3% on three samples; RSD < 5%; no CRM

unresolved: Abstract ranges (Cd 0.0002-0.014, Pb 0-2.0 mg/kg) do not match Table 4 (Cd up to 0.0240, Pb up to 0.2000 mg/kg).
Text says Hg was below detection in the remaining ten samples, but Table 4 prints non-zero Hg for MF-8 (0.0003) and MF-12 (0.0025) as well.
Stated ICP-AES detection limits (0.05-0.5 µg/kg) are far below what ICP-AES normally achieves for As, Hg and Pb.
Whole-wheat status of the pastas not stated.
Accepted manuscript (Article in Press, unedited); collection dates not reported.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Daily pasta intake used for DI
